The '''Masked Killer '''is an enemy in [[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|''Ninja Gaiden (NES)'']] and [[Ninja Gaiden II: The Dark Sword of Chaos|''Ninja Gaiden II: The Dark Sword of Chaos'']]''.'' They are an obvious spoof of Jason Voorhees, a popular serial killer in horror/slasher media.

[[File:13000-ninja-gaiden-ii-the-dark-sword-of-chaos-dos-screenshot-the.gif|thumb|320x320px|Masked Killer in Ninja Gaiden II.]]

=='''[[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]]'''== 
[[File:MaskedKillerNES1.png|80px]]

First appearing in [[Temple of Darkness -Hall of Demons-|Act 4-3]], Masked Killers are potentially one of the most dangerous enemies in the game. They are a palette swap of the [[Banshee]]s and [[Jack O' Murderer]]s and [[Mace Man|Mace Men]] and do the same thing, their weapon of choice being axes. Both their contact and axe attacks do 1 damage, and they are best defeated using sub-weapons to work around the axes.
